gloss: business card case; business card holder

definitions.gloss: business card case; business card holder
definitions.explanation: A small case or holder for carrying and presenting business cards. Considered an essential professional accessory in Japan, where business card exchange is a formal ritual.

examples.english: I bought a leather business card case.

examples.japanese: {名刺入|めいしい}れ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}した→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧。
examples.english: I took a business card out of the case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧になった⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{名刺入|めいしい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My father gave me a business card case as a present for starting my career.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧ (business card) + ⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (holder, container). In Japanese business culture, presenting and receiving a business card from a clean, well-kept case is part of basic etiquette.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名刺入|めいしい}れ: leather business card case
- {名刺入|めいしい}れ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to take out of the case
- {名刺入|めいしい}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しまう: to put away in the case
- {名刺入|めいしい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to forget one's business card case

CULTURAL NOTE:
When receiving a business card from someone of higher rank, the proper etiquette is to place the received card on top of the {名刺入|めいしい}れ rather than putting it away immediately, as a sign of respect.
